parameters.reasoning: The paper uses VASP with a plane-wave basis set (500 eV cutoff) and PBE functional. SIESTA uses NAO basis, so plane-wave cutoff has no equivalent. The paper states a 2D monolayer with vacuum spacing of 15 Å, so the vacuum axis must have exactly 1 k-point. The paper specifies k-meshes (13×13×1 for geometry optimization, 21×21×1 for electronic structure), so kgrid will be set to 21 for electronic structure. Basis size: DZP is standard for production. Mesh cutoff: 300 Ry chosen for light elements (C2Si) as a safe value. XC functional: PBE maps to GGA/PBE.
